summary: Medieval Swahili sultanate based on the island of Kilwa Kisiwani off the coast of present-day Tanzania. It grew rich from the Indian Ocean trade in gold and ivory, built stone mosques and a palace, and was attacked by Portugal in 1505.

events.note: The traditional founding date, from the Kilwa Chronicle. Some historians place the founding later.

cause: Weakened after a Portuguese attack in 1505 and later absorbed by outside powers
